## Purpose
The app-level owner of background runs, mounted once in the shell. It reattaches to runs still going at the last load, picks up runs started in other tabs, refreshes the lists a finished run changed, and announces each finish with a link back.

## Responsibilities
- Polls `runsApi.list` and calls `mergeServerRuns`. Reconnects every run that is still running.
- `onRunFinished`:
- - invalidates the queries the run kind changed (agents, tools, workflows);
- - shows a toast with an open link through `useOpenRun`.
- A run that built, but whose checks or test scenarios did not all pass, is reported as a draft.

## Key elements
`BackgroundRuns`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
Reads the runs store and connections.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Uses `lib/runs/connections`, `stores/runs` and `runMeta`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **A dialog watching a synthesis reports its own outcome,** so there is no duplicate toast.
- **A code fix builds a new activity version,** so the activity lists are refreshed.

Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
